description: The `impai-handicap` test group's economy structures, applied to impai-handicap.json, keeping every unit already there (the commanders): for seat 1 (OTA AI) and seat 2 (ImpAI) each, finished, a CORE solar collector, wind generator, metal extractor and metal maker on dry ground and a tidal generator in water, so the economy pass 0x401360 runs the Difficulty type tests of rows 1 (a structure's negative EnergyUse), 2 (a powered extractor's metal), 3 (a metal maker), 4 (wind) and 5 (tide) for both seats, with no order the stock AI could replace. The maker's test runs only while the maker is switched on (+0x10E bit 0, 0x4013C5) and granted its energy (no debt at +0xC8, 0x4013F9..0x40141F); the applier creates it switched on, and the stock AI's structure planner 0x4086D0 switches a maker off only when twice the stored metal is at least the stored energy (0x40871E..0x40877F), which impai-handicap.json's starting resources keep from happening (its description). MEASURED 2026-11-12: both makers switched on throughout, and rows 1 to 5 counted on both seats by GameTime 420. The tide's type test runs for a switched-on structure with a TidalGenerator above 0 that is no extractor, maker or wind generator (0x4015BC..0x4015F3), whatever the map's tidal strength, which only multiplies the grant. Seat 1's structures stand in a dry, flat 320 wu box round (7024, 1712) with its tide 460 wu north-west in water at least 24 deep; seat 2's in the box round (5848, 6744) with its tide 272 wu east, about 5100 wu from seat 1's. Heights read from the map's attribute grid: 80 to 85 on the boxes against the sea's 75, at most 51 under each tide's 128 wu square (CORTIDE wants 20 of depth).
